rules.title: Eviction for nonpayment of rent requires rental debt of at least one month’s Fair Market Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may only evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent if the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont metro area as determined by HUD for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.summary_plain: You cannot be evicted for not paying rent unless you owe at least one month’s Fair Market Rent for a similar unit.
rules.summary_plain_es: No pueden desalojarte por no pagar la renta a menos que debas al menos un mes de la Renta Justa de Mercado para una unidad similar.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions_text: Units exempt from Rent Ordinance coverage including some government-subsidized units as specified by federal, state, or administrative law.
rules.quoted_span: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is no longer allowed for rental debt less than one month of the Fair Market Rent for the unit

rules.title: No eviction for failure to sign a new fixed term lease
rules.requirement: A landlord may not evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.key_value: No eviction for failure to sign new lease
rules.summary_plain: You cannot be evicted just because you refuse to sign a new lease that is substantially the same as the old one.
rules.summary_plain_es: No pueden desalojarte solo porque te niegues a firmar un nuevo contrato que sea sustancialmente igual al anterior.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions_text: Units exempt from Rent Ordinance coverage including some government-subsidized units as specified by federal, state, or administrative law.
rules.quoted_span: Tenants can no longer be evicted for failing to sign a substantially similar lease

rules.title: Eviction for lease breach requires unreasonable tenant behavior causing actual harm
rules.requirement: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach, demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and show that the breach caused actual harm to the landlord. Eviction is not allowed for breaches that do not cause actual harm.
rules.summary_plain: You can only be evicted for lease violations if your behavior was unreasonable and caused real harm to the landlord, and the landlord must clearly explain the violation.
rules.summary_plain_es: Solo pueden desalojarte por violaciones al contrato si tu comportamiento fue irrazonable y causó daño real al propietario, y el propietario debe explicar claramente la violación.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions_text: Units exempt from Rent Ordinance coverage including some government-subsidized units as specified by federal, state, or administrative law.
rules.quoted_span: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.

rules.title: Eviction notices must include Rent Board information and be filed with Rent Board
rules.requirement: Eviction notices must contain information directing tenants to the Rent Board, including phone number and website, and landlords must file copies of eviction notices and lawsuits with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.
rules.summary_plain: Eviction notices must tell you about the Rent Board and landlords must file copies of eviction papers with the Rent Board quickly.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los avisos de desalojo deben informarte sobre la Junta de Alquileres y los propietarios deben presentar copias de los documentos de desalojo a la Junta rápidamente.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions_text: Units exempt from Rent Ordinance coverage including some government-subsidized units as specified by federal, state, or administrative law.
rules.quoted_span: Eviction notices must contain certain information directing tenants to the Rent Board, and copies of eviction notices and eviction lawsuits must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.

rules.title: Utility charges must be included in base rent or separately metered and in tenant’s name
rules.requirement: For tenancies starting on or after February 6, 2024, landlords may charge tenants for utilities only if the cost is included in the base rent or if the utility is separately metered and the lease requires the tenant to place the utility account in their name.
rules.key_value: Utility charges included in rent or separately metered
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a fully covered unit starting after Feb 6, 2024, utility charges must be part of your rent or separately metered and in your name.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquilas una unidad cubierta completamente después del 6 de febrero de 2024, los cargos por servicios públicos deben estar incluidos en la renta o medidos por separado y a tu nombre.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Fully covered rental units in Berkeley.
rules.exemptions_text: Units not fully covered by the Rent Ordinance or exempt units.
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies starting on or after February 6, 2024, a landlord may charge a tenant in a fully covered unit for utilities only if either: the cost of the utilities are part of the base rent, or the utility service is separately-metered and the lease requires the tenant to place the utility in the tenant’s name.

rules.title: Annual General Adjustment capped at 5%
rules.requirement: The maximum Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for rent increases is capped at 5% per year, even if the formula based on the Consumer Price Index results in a higher percentage.
rules.summary_plain: Your rent can only be increased by up to 5% per year under the Annual General Adjustment.
rules.summary_plain_es: Tu renta solo puede aumentar hasta un 5% por año bajo el Ajuste General Anual.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Units fully covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions_text: Units partially covered or exempt from Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
